subject: Request: Minimal-scope subprocessor list + temporary onshore proxy option for FinTrust pilot
messages:
From: Asha Patel <asha@fintrust.com>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Data Security <security@fintrust.com>
Date: 2028-05-02T16:14:00Z
Subject: Request: subprocessor list + onshore proxy for pilot

Hi Hannah / Marissa,

Thanks again for the demo last week — team was impressed with the latency numbers. Before we spin up the pilot, our security and procurement teams need an updated, minimal-scope subprocessor list scoped to the pilot dataset, plus confirmation of any temporary onshore proxy options (US-only) you can offer so data does not cross into other jurisdictions during the trial.

Specifically we need:
- A one-page manifest of subprocessors that will touch pilot data (names, country, purpose, encryption-in-transit/e2e notes)
- Any temporary onshore proxy or edge option and an outline of controls (timebound, access list)
- Evidence: SOC 2 date, KMS/domains used, and a contact for quick attestations

Goal: get this to our security team within 72 hours if possible. Pilot goes live 2028-05-11, so tight window.

Thanks — Asha

Asha Patel
Head of Data Operations, FinTrust
asha@fintrust.com

From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.com>
To: Asha Patel <asha@fintrust.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-05-02T17:01:00Z
Subject: Re: Request: subprocessor list + onshore proxy for pilot

Hi Asha — thanks for the clear list. Looping in our security (Ben) and legal (Laura) to assemble a minimal-scope manifest and proposed temporary onshore proxy controls.

We can provide a scoped manifest limited to pilot resources and a timebound addendum to our DPA (no long-term changes) for the pilot period. I will:
- Share a manifest draft and an onshore-proxy config summary within 24 business hours
- Share a DPA addendum redline for the pilot (timebox + limited subprocessor access)

Attaching a quick stub we use internally for manifests; final will include SOC2 reference and KMS region.

Hannah
Director, Customer Security Operations
Redwood Inference

Attachment: subprocessor_manifest_template.csv (stub)

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Asha Patel <asha@fintrust.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-05-03T01:08:00Z
Subject: Re: Request: subprocessor list + onshore proxy for pilot

Thanks Hannah — quick technical note from security. For a US-only pilot we can stand up a temporary onshore proxy configuration using our partner EdgeShield (partner on US data residency). Proposed controls:
- Timebound tunnel (pilot window) with allowlist of FinTrust IPs
- No persistent logs retained beyond 7 days for pilot requests (configurable)
- KV cache scoped to tenant and zero-copy eviction at end of pilot
- KMS keys provisioned in us-east-1 (customer-facing attest)

I'll attach a 1-page config summary for EdgeShield and list the minimal evidence we can supply immediately: SOC2 date, KMS region, recent penetration test summary (redacted). If FinTrust needs an HSM attestation we can escalate but it will add lead time.

Ben Carter
Senior Security Engineer, Redwood Inference

Attachment: edge_shield_config_summary.pdf

From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
To: Asha Patel <asha@fintrust.com>, Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-05-03T11:34:00Z
Subject: Re: Request: subprocessor list + onshore proxy for pilot

Hi Asha — attaching a short DPA addendum draft that would cover the pilot: limited to the pilot dataset, explicit list of subprocessors for the pilot, and a one-month post-pilot data retention/escrow obligation. Key points:
- Clause limiting subprocessor authorization to pilot scope and dates listed in Exhibit A
- Right to audit for pilot period with 48-hour notice for evidence (SOC2, KMS metadata)
- Automatic rollback/disconnect at pilot end and certificate/key rotation

We've also prepared a manifest (v1) for the subset of partners likely to be involved; it's intentionally minimal and labeled as "pilot-only." Please review and confirm if anything is missing.

Laura Bennett
Senior Counsel, Privacy & Contracts 
Redwood Inference

Attachments: redwood_dpa_addendum_draft.docx, subprocessor_manifest_v1.xlsx

From: Asha Patel <asha@fintrust.com>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-05-04T10:22:00Z
Subject: Re: Request: subprocessor list + onshore proxy for pilot

Team — this is great, thank you. Quick confirmation:
- Manifest looks fine at a glance; we will circulate to our security reviewers with the pilot scope (please keep it locked to the pilot IDs).
- Onshore proxy controls acceptable. Please confirm the 7-day log retention in writing and include the KMS key ID / region.
- Laura — can you prep a DocuSign for the one-week pilot addendum (FT sign + Redwood sign)? We will need the signed addendum before provisioning.

If you can get the DocuSign link and the final manifest in the next 24 hours we can proceed to provisioning. HubSpot: I filed this under HUBSPOT-2345678 and requested a fast-track review.

Thanks,
Asha
